summary: Shared embedder constants and paths for daemon, clients, keeper and hooks: model id, DIM, RECIPE, PROTOCOL, ROLES prefixes, embedKey, cache/model/socket paths, opt-in/opt-out flag paths. TOKEN_CAPS is per role: note_doc and note_query embed the WHOLE text (8192 guard) because the recall gate's weights were fit on untruncated transformers.js vectors — a 512 cap flipped 1/200 gate decisions (a 630-token query); file_doc and code_query stay at 512. RECIPE is gemma2-q4-mean-l2-caps-v2; any change to caps, prefixes or runtime glue must bump it so every key changes and the store rebuilds.

summary: Shared embedder constants and paths for daemon, clients, keeper and hooks: model id, DIM, RECIPE, PROTOCOL, ROLES prefixes, embedKey, cache/model/socket paths, opt-in/opt-out flag paths. TOKEN_CAPS (note roles 2048, code_query/file_doc 512) + WINDOWED_ROLES decide what happens past the cap: truncate, or windowed pooling for notes. Chosen by measurement on the 200 v3 recall-gate prompts vs whole-text vectors: whole text 200/200 decisions but 18 s / ~4 GB for the 6k-token note and a watchdog trip at 2 threads for 8k; truncate@2048 198/200; windows@2048 199/200. RECIPE is gemma2-q4-mean-l2-win2048-v3; any change to caps, windowing, prefixes or runtime glue must bump it so every key changes and the store rebuilds.

summary: Shared embedder constants and paths for daemon, clients, keeper and hooks: model id, DIM, RECIPE, PROTOCOL, ROLES prefixes, embedKey, cache/model/socket paths, opt-in/opt-out flag paths. TOKEN_CAPS (note_doc/note_query 1024, code_query/file_doc 512) + WINDOWED_ROLES decide truncate vs windowed pooling past the cap. Note windows are 1024, not 2048, since RECIPE gemma2-q4-mean-l2-win1024-mp0-v4 (2026-11-19): ORT keeps the peak arena of the longest run, so daemon backfill peak RSS went 2079 → 1446 MB, and the shipped recall gate's decisions on 1024-windowed notes matched 2048 on 577/580 eval prompts (512 lost a little; overlap, structure-split, head-only and best-chunk scoring gave no consistent gain; pilots in ~/coldstart-rag/scripts/pilot-window/). threadPlan(perfCores) is the daemon's thread table (owner rule): perf 4 → 2+2, 6+ → 4+2, ≤3 → 1+1; it lives here so tests can import it (the daemon script runs on import). embedKey hashes RECIPE, so bumping it re-embeds every vector; any change to caps, windowing, prefixes or ORT session options that changes vectors must bump it.

summary: Shared embedder constants and paths for daemon, clients, keeper and hooks: model id, DIM, RECIPE, PROTOCOL, ROLES prefixes, embedKey, cache/model/socket paths, opt-in/opt-out flag paths. PROTOCOL covers the socket AND the daemon↔model-process IPC: 2 (2026-11-22) = the daemon tokenizes and model processes get ids; the client replaces a live daemon of an older protocol (measured: protocol-1 daemon stopped, protocol-2 one up, query OK, no leftovers) and never a newer one. socketPath hashes user + COLDSTART_HOME, so a scratch COLDSTART_HOME gets its own daemon. TOKEN_CAPS (note_doc/note_query 1024, code_query/file_doc 512) + WINDOWED_ROLES decide truncate vs windowed pooling past the cap; note windows are 1024 since RECIPE gemma2-q4-mean-l2-win1024-mp0-v4 (ORT keeps the peak arena of the longest run; gate decisions on 1024 windows matched 2048 on 577/580 eval prompts). threadPlan(perfCores) is the daemon's thread table: perf 4 → 2+2, 6+ → 4+2, ≤3 → 1+1. embedKey hashes RECIPE, so bumping it re-embeds every vector; any change to caps, windowing, prefixes or ORT session options that changes vectors must bump it (the tokenizer swap did not: ids identical).
